After looking into this more closely, I can now narrow the issue down.

I did this with PostgreSQL and anlysed which entries apear more than once in the table
with the following SQL query after the succesfull rebuild:

select search_resource_rdf_type.*,
       string_agg(search_rdf_type.rdf_type_uri, ', '),

from search_resource_rdf_type
     inner join search_rdf_type on search_resource_rdf_type.rdf_type_id = search_rdf_type.id

I was able to reproduce this with your sample data,
. I did a git bisect and it looks like the speed improvements is causing the issue.

fields.summary: rebuild fails in Fedora 7 RC 1 because of duplicate key constraints for certain OCFL repositories

comments.body: I will provide more information on how to reproduce this bug and the logs for MariaDB and MySQL later today, but I wanted to get the information out there.

After looking into this more closely, I can now narrow the issue down.

When I remove the constraint in search_resource_rdf_type_pkey on the table search_resource_rdf_type, the index rebuild succeeds.

I did this with PostgreSQL and anlysed which entries apear more than once in the table search_resource_rdf_type with the following SQL query after the succesfull rebuild:

select search_resource_rdf_type.*,
       string_agg(search_rdf_type.rdf_type_uri, ', '),
       string_agg(simple_search.fedora_id, ', ')
from search_resource_rdf_type
     inner join search_rdf_type on search_resource_rdf_type.rdf_type_id = search_rdf_type.id
     inner join simple_search on search_resource_rdf_type.resource_id = simple_search.id
group by search_resource_rdf_type.resource_id, search_resource_rdf_type.rdf_type_id
having count(*) > 1
order by search_resource_rdf_type.resource_id, search_resource_rdf_type.rdf_type_id;

Here are the results from a smaller test dataset: Duplicates-in-search_resource_rdf_type-after-rebuild.txt

I was able to reproduce this with your sample data, Thomas Bernhart. I did a git bisect and it looks like the speed improvements is causing the issue.
https://github.com/fcrepo/fcrepo/commit/1e16e2b67f501fa26f820a02a427a460e3c51b26#diff-392c86d15f3faa8d7723a10f406af3455e3d78458cde6561879c1e9749f08fee

Currently I think the not using of the cache is the issue.
https://github.com/fcrepo/fcrepo/blob/059451eedb1da0eb9d2cd8624bc40c22650c5413/fcrepo-search-impl/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/search/impl/DbSearchIndexImpl.java#L800-L806

I added some debugging and the rdf types it is failing on are not in the search_rdf_types table. I’m not exactly sure how they end up in the cache and not in the table.
